shortDescription: Write role fingerprint data to syslog and optionally to a JSONL log file

options.name: ansible_play_hosts_all
options.description: All hosts in the play, typically C({{ ansible_play_hosts_all }}). Used to derive C(play_hosts_number).

options.name: distribution
options.description: OS distribution name, typically C({{ ansible_facts["distribution"] }}).

options.name: distribution_version
options.description: OS distribution version, typically C({{ ansible_facts["distribution_version"] }}).

options.name: log_file
options.description: Path to the JSONL log file. A lock sidecar (C(<log_file>.lock)) is created next to the log file for cross-process safety.

options.name: max_log_size
options.description: Maximum log file size in bytes. When appending a new record would exceed this limit, the oldest records are removed first. Set to C(0) to disable trimming.

options.name: role_name
options.description: Name of the role, typically C({{ role_name }}).

options.name: role_path
options.description: Path to the role, typically C({{ role_path }}).

options.name: write_log_file
options.description: If C(true), append fingerprint data to the JSONL log file. Defaults to C(false).
